g.title: None.None.Node.1
g.text: AWS event-driven order processing with Lambda in a VPC

g.title: None.None.Node.30
g.text: The mobile app posts the order to the REST API, where AWS WAF filters the request
API Gateway checks the customer's token with the Cognito authorizer
It invokes the create-order Lambda in a private subnet
The Lambda saves the order to DynamoDB through the gateway endpoint
and queues an order event on SQS through the interface endpoint
The queue triggers the fulfilment Lambda; messages that fail five times move to the dead-letter queue
The Lambda marks the order fulfilled in DynamoDB
and publishes a notification to SNS through the interface endpoint
Deliveries that fail land in the notifications dead-letter queue for replay
DynamoDB streams every order change to Kinesis Data Streams
and writes hourly Parquet files to the S3 archive
A Glue crawler adds new partitions to the Data Catalog
Analysts query the archive with Athena
